method: Directory only, after WordPress bootstrap; three calls per process. Cold invalidates only this directory before timing. Warm must run in a separate process. Includes cache SQL, not full-page TTFB.

queries: SELECT DISTINCT pm.meta_value FROM wp_postmeta pm INNER JOIN wp_posts p ON p.ID = pm.post_id WHERE pm.meta_key = '_recipe_region' AND p.post_type = 'recipe' AND p.post_status = 'publish' AND p.post_password = '' ORDER BY pm.meta_value
